title: send_request: serialize-then-mutate-JSON is fragile for @type injection
description: ws/mod.rs send_request: The @type injection serializes req to serde_json::Value, mutates the map, then re-serializes to String. This creates two serde_json allocations per call and couples the frame format to the shape of JmapRequest's JSON serialization. A wrapper struct with #[serde(flatten)] + @type + id fields would serialize directly in one pass: 'struct WsRequestFrame { at_type: &str, id: Option<&str>, #[serde(flatten)] req: &JmapRequest }'. This is not purely aesthetic — the current pattern will silently produce wrong output if JmapRequest ever serializes to a non-object (e.g. if the type changes), degrading to the InvalidArgument error path. The wrapper approach makes the type constraint compile-time.
